description: This file defines the main React component `NotesApp` for a personal notes manager application. It includes UI for listing, searching, creating, editing, saving, and deleting notes, with autosave functionality and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: clampTitle
methods.description: Ensures the note title is not empty; defaults to 'Untitled' if input is empty.

methods.name: snippet
methods.description: Returns a trimmed and possibly truncated preview of the note body for display in the list.

methods.name: isMac
methods.description: Detects if the current platform is Mac based on the navigator platform.

methods.name: shortcutHint
methods.description: Returns the appropriate keyboard shortcut hint ('⌘S' or 'Ctrl+S') based on the platform.

methods.name: NotesApp
methods.description: Main React component implementing the notes management UI with listing, searching, editing, saving, and deletion functionalities.
